name: gap_status_fixture_template
honesty: Hand-label template for verify.py eval — not production data. Supporting notes are private local notes; not in the public tree.

label_schema.veritas_cousin: optional: supported | refuted | underpowered | invalid_form — research labels; map carefully to gold_status
label_schema.related_but_unanswered: boolean — literature neighborhood exists but does not settle the question

items.question_text: REPLACE: A precise unanswered question where many related papers exist.
items.notes: Expect verify to keep unanswered/partial — not flip to answered on weak overlap. underpowered ≠ refuted.

items.question_text: REPLACE: A question that a specific landmark paper settles.
items.notes: Expect answered or partially_answered with high overlap.

items.question_text: REPLACE: Two unrelated questions glued with and/or sprawl.
items.notes: critique_brief should flag sprawl; do not treat as high-value unanswered.
